description: This file contains a Python script implementing utility classes and functions for managing HTTP requests, batch processing of CSV data, and creating users and keys via API calls. It appears to be part of a larger project that handles user and key management with a proxy API, using asynchronous HTTP requests and CSV data processing.

classes.name: HTTPHandler
classes.description: A class providing asynchronous HTTP client functionality with connection pooling, supporting GET and POST requests.

methods.name: HTTPHandler.__init__
methods.description: Initializes an HTTP client with specified connection limits.

methods.name: HTTPHandler.close
methods.description: Closes the HTTP client connection pool.

methods.name: import_sheet
methods.description: Reads a CSV sheet, creates users and keys via API calls concurrently, and writes back results with generated keys.

methods.name: create_user
methods.description: Creates a new user and associated key via API endpoints, using the provided user details.

methods.name: create_key_with_alias
methods.description: Requests the generation of a key with specific alias and max budget for a user via API.
